Chapter 649: Chapter 2: The Supreme Being'S Surprise (5000 Words, Please Subscribe)_3

Chapter 649: Chapter 2: The Supreme Being’s Surprise (5000 words, please subscribe)_3

After all, customizing a single shuttle through the World-Breaking Origin Force starts with a hundred strands. Such a great cost would not be considered by Lin Yuan without seeing enormous gains.

…

“The Tenth Rank Chapter of the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path mainly discusses the essence of the ‘Rule of Time’.”

“Similarly, the Tenth Rank Chapter of the Xia You Evolutionary Path also discusses the essence of the ‘Rule of Time’.”

“Both are discussing the essence of the Rule of Time, yet they are completely different.”

Lin Yuan was amazed in his heart.

...

The Xia You Evolutionary Path is one of the nine great Supreme Evolution Paths of human civilization, with its ultimate being the Xia Qin Supreme Being.

With the wealth Lin Yuan currently possessed, even without counting the gains from the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, he could afford to purchase all nine of the great Supreme Evolution Paths of human civilization.

The primary use of the Supreme Evolution Path for Lin Yuan was for enlightenment and reference.

To thoroughly understand the understanding of the essence of the rules and then integrate it into the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

“Time…”

Lin Yuan’s gaze was calm as he took out the ‘Miniature Universe’ to experience the complete operation of the Rule of Time within it.

“So far I have comprehended one thousand eight hundred twenty-three Rule Models of Time, but my understanding of time is becoming ever more perplexed,” he remarked.

Lin Yuan showed a thoughtful expression.

If he had not entered the Rule of Time yet, he might have thought that was all there was to it.

But as his contemplation of the Rule of Time deepened, he could feel how insignificant he was.

In front of the vast and eternal River of Time, what was he? Even as an Eleventh-Rank Life, he was just a slightly bigger fish.

Only the existence of a Supreme Being could completely leap out of the River of Time and exist eternally.

“The one thousand eight hundred twenty-third Time Model, still far from understanding the Complete Rule of Time,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Currently, the scholars of human civilization have summed up a total of two thousand one hundred seventy-three Time Models.

But that does not mean comprehending these two thousand one hundred seventy-three Time Models would lead to understanding the Complete Rule of Time.

Unlike the Space Rules, the countless evolutionary scholars of human civilization already have a more mature understanding of the Space Rules.

Comprehending all the core Space Models would lead to understanding the Complete Space Rules.

But the Rule of Time? Even if one comprehends all the currently known Time Rule Models, it is not enough to understand the Complete Rule of Time.

To understand the Complete Rule of Time, one can only rely on oneself.

No matter how many Time Rule Models exist, they are just assistance; the final step can only be crossed by oneself.

“In contemplating the Rule of Time, I have finally hit a bottleneck…” Lin Yuan stopped contemplating.

Even with Against-Heaven’s Understanding and the complete operation of the Rule of Time in the Miniature Universe, Lin Yuan’s comprehension of the next Time Rule Model came to a halt.

This was unsurprisingly normal. Encountering a bottleneck in pondering the Rule of Time? Isn’t that to be expected?

And the Miniature Universe? Its Rule of Time just makes it a little easier for the owner to contemplate the Rule of Time, not to directly master the World Rule.

If the Miniature Universe had that capability, why would it only appear in the reward store of the third and fourth floors of the Nine Floors Dark Tower?

“Perhaps I can consult the Supreme Being?” Lin Yuan suddenly thought.

This feeling of being in a bottleneck was only temporary and should not trap Lin Yuan for long.

But if there is a shortcut available, why persist the hard way?

Ever since his last meeting with Xia Qin Supreme Being, the latter had clearly stated that Lin Yuan could come to him anytime if there were questions about cultivation he did not understand.

“Let’s ask and see,” he said.

Lin Yuan immediately began contacting Xia Qin Supreme Being.

It happened to be that he also had some doubts about contemplating the Xia You Evolutionary Path, and this was a good time to ask about them as well.

…

Atop the majestic Evolution Tower.

Xia Qin Supreme Being suddenly opened his eyes.

“Hmm?”

“That kid is actually seeking me out?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being received Lin Yuan’s message, a smile appearing on his face.

He almost thought Lin Yuan had forgotten about him, this Supreme Being.

Is it a cultivation-related question he wants to ask me? Xia Qin Supreme Being was in a good mood.

A genius like Lin Yuan is absolutely unprecedented in human history.

Although it is still very uncertain whether he will become a Supreme Being, guiding such a historically unique genius still gives Xia Qin Supreme Being a sense of accomplishment.

“Come over here,” he said.

Xia Qin Supreme Being agreed to meet Lin Yuan.

Immediately.

Lin Yuan’s form appeared below.

“I greet Xia Qin Supreme Being,” Lin Yuan respectfully said.

This is still the Virtual World, but it is the personal world of the Supreme Being, where no outsider can enter without the Supreme Being’s permission.

Even a peerless genius like Lin Yuan had to notify the Supreme Being to enter.

“Get up,” he said.

“Tell me your questions.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being watched Lin Yuan with interest.

He was curious about Lin Yuan’s questions regarding cultivation.

Given Lin Yuan’s performance in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm and its spatial layers, what could he be questioning?

The puzzlements of the Ninth Rank cultivation?

Or the queries about the transition from the Ninth Rank to the Tenth Rank?

Or perhaps the misunderstanding of some aspects of spatial essence?

Xia Qin Supreme Being’s thoughts fluctuated as he wondered which aspect Lin Yuan would ask about.

He speculated that Lin Yuan’s queries would be related to space, given that he was only at the Ninth Rank, even if he had opened up many Spatial Layers, he was still of the Ninth Rank, and that was the extent of his involvement.

“Xia Qin Supreme Being…” Lin Yuan pondered for a moment and then asked earnestly, “I have some misunderstandings about the Three You Time Index in the Xia You Evolutionary Path… Is the Three You Time Index three different states of time or a time vortex entangled in a Three You shape?”

About the Three You Time Index in the Xia You Evolutionary Path concerning different states of time zones, Lin Yuan compared it continuously with the models of the Rule of Time, causing some slight confusion about the details.

“The Xia You Evolutionary Path?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being’s eyebrows raised; this was the Evolutionary Path he established.

But then, Xia Qin Supreme Being was stunned.

The Three You Time Index, wasn’t that content from the Eleventh Stage Volume of the Xia You Evolutionary Path?
